content:
Alyssa Chen: Putting together a one-pager for security-conscious enterprise buyers. Aim: short benchmark highlight, clear webinar hook, and explicit inbound routing for leads that mention security/SLAs/private deploys. Dropping a compact draft below for quick feedback.

Mike R: Uploaded copy to Drive: https://drive.redwood/field-brief-v1. Suggest headline: 'Predictable latency. Verified SLAs.' Keep numbers in a callout rather than headline.

Jordan Lee: Bench notes to include: workload = mixed chat + 2k-token generation; steady-state at 4 concurrent streams; median latency improved from ~280ms to ~95ms; cost delta ~40% lower/token with batching + prefix cache. Add tiny methodology blurb: controlled runs vs common managed endpoint.

Samira Patel: Inbound routing proposal: tag leads with [security, private-deploy, on-prem, vpc] -> AE+SE queue + auto-schedule Solutions Workshop. Pseudo-rule below.

Samira Patel: ```
if lead.tags intersects ["security","private-deploy","on-prem","vpc"]:
  assign = "enterprise-ae"
  notify = ["AE-priority","SE-security"]
  next_step = "invite-solutions-workshop"
end
```

Noah Gomez: Add a form checkbox: 'Require private/VPC or Dedicated capacity?' -> if checked, auto-tag. Webinar CTA text: 'See private deployments + SLA walkthrough.'

Jordan Lee: Webinar flow suggestion: 20m benchmark walkthrough, 25m live Q&A (SE), 15m compliance breakout rooms. We'll A/B test a compliance-forward subject line.

Mike R: One-pager layout: TL;DR problem statement, benchmark callout (numbers + short methodology), deployment matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) with SLA/isolation notes, CTA + routing snippet + webinar link.

Alyssa Chen: Action items: Mike finalize OOO-friendly copy by EOD; Jordan prepare 2 small charts (median/p99 + cost); Samira/Noah finalize tags and form change. I'll assemble and schedule 30-min sync tomorrow morning. :calendar: 

marketing-bot: Reminder set: 'Field brief final review' tomorrow 9:30 AM PT.
